mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, conditions are clear near Verona Area High School with temperatures holding steady at 69 degrees under a New Moon.

City Hall reminds residents of the upcoming Fall Partisan Primary election. Additionally, please be aware that road construction on Highway M begins on August 18, which will shift traffic patterns and include some lane closures.
Today, you can enjoy the Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and Hop Haus trivia.
On August 6, an officer arrested a 49-year-old man for his fourth O W I offence after observing erratic driving.
You can enjoy today's flavor, Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The shop is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor is Devil's Food Cake.
